validation: Reject compressed data rather than parse encoded characters as numbers
Require at least two finite points
Check X range against selected spectrum type
Preserve source and experimental metadata separately from decoded points
Parse PAC compact signed values without splitting exponent signs
Decode SQZ positive/negative pseudo-digits and DIF positive/negative deltas
Expand DUP counts, including DIFDUP repeated differences
Drop repeated Y-checkpoint at continuation rows after DIF encoding
Reject malformed tokens and enforce NPOINTS after decompression
Reject the JCAMP undefined/off-scale ordinate marker (?) instead of silently bridging across a missing measurement.
Cross-check decoded XYDATA first and last abscissas against FIRSTX/LASTX with half-step tolerance; reject inconsistent headers.
Accepter les variable-lists NMR 1D Y/R/I et conserver l’identité real/imaginary; rejeter les autres formes XYDATA non implémentées.
Automatically extract available JCAMP LDR metadata into a separate import metadata object; metadata extraction does not certify provenance or experimental validity.

implemented_features: Afficher les canaux NTUPLES RMN 1D R et I séparément ou en superposition, sans fusion mathématique ni correction de phase automatique.
notes: La superposition R/I est une visualisation comparative uniquement; elle ne constitue pas une correction de phase ni un spectre absorbance reconstruit.
